recent_central_points.title: Reel cover "Google Reps Aren't Your Marketing Strategist"
recent_central_points.key_message: Google reps work for Google: they push you to spend more and try new features, but they don't know your business or your client journey.

recent_central_points.title: "Google's recommendations aren't always what's best for your wedding business."
recent_central_points.key_message: Google's own recommendations serve Google's goals and aren't always what's best for a wedding business.

recent_central_points.title: Reel cover "Are Your Google Ads Actually Working?"
recent_central_points.key_message: Many wedding pros can't tell whether their Google Ads are actually working; an outside audit gives a clear picture before engagement season.

recent_central_points.title: "Engagement season is right around the corner."
recent_central_points.key_message: Engagement season is when couples start searching, so make sure your Google Ads are working before it starts.

recent_central_points.title: "Wedding Pros: Are you totally sure your Google Ads are doing what they're supposed to?"
recent_central_points.key_message: If your freelancer or agency isn't showing you what's actually working in your Google Ads, you can't be sure your ads are working.

recent_central_points.title: 2026 Google Ads Audit Giveaway (apply by 16 Oct): announcement, engagement-season and deadline captions; three carousels; three Reels
recent_central_points.key_message: Announcement: five wedding businesses can apply, by 16 October, for a free Google Ads audit.

recent_central_points.title: "What I taught my clients this week" (UVP training)
recent_central_points.key_message: Advertising starts before the ads: define your unique value proposition before you write an ad or build a landing page.

recent_central_points.title: 10-week case study: Reel "What would happen if your wedding business didn't post on Instagram for the next 10 weeks?"; carousel "You don't need another reminder to 'show up consistently.'"; captions "There's a difference between wanting to do less marketing…" and "'I couldn't do it all.'"; email "She didn't post on Instagram for 10 weeks"
recent_central_points.key_message: Ads kept a wedding planner in front of potential clients while she let Instagram go quiet for 10 weeks: a strategy has to allow for the times you can't show up.

recent_central_points.title: New welcome DM: "This is Whitney. (Real human, not a bot 😂)… What brought you to our page?"
recent_central_points.key_message: A real person, Whitney, welcomes each new follower and asks what brought them to the page.
